blocking.movement: actual hard member union; preserve openings and interior voids
blocking.rays: actual material surfaces at their z; no whole silhouette occluder
blocking.native_selection: handoff only; no runtime behavior/binding selected

source_conflicts: S/W originals expose interior floor and omit one long barred face. It may be a literal opening or artist cutaway; source does not establish a sealed four-sided cage. Proposed three-sided cage preserves that gap and is not a certified closure state.
notes: Dimensions and bar count are coarse proposals; topology is not read from Blender. Strong pose-dependent contact offsets are preserved.

animation_registration.interpretation: Animation/media registration only, not a contact/footprint/mount height. No offsets or states adjusted.

source_geometry_limitations.method: Blender source-UV thin meshes with semantic material masks and keyed authored deformation. Support buckling precedes connected cloth folding; source-visible rims and sides detach separately. No filled hull or voxel partition. Every raw frame rendered in Blender.
source_geometry_limitations.limitation: Each camera has a separately source-mapped Blender mesh collection, not a shared 3D model or simulation. Hidden faces cannot be recovered. C3 rear-wheel hidden rim is explicitly inferred and revealed as the barrel moves away. B23 has an explicitly inferred undecorated source-palette bottom/edge behind detached sides and lid. Floor and bones lower together after support loss; the hidden interior is not recovered original geometry. Cloth folds and cage buckling are authored shape keys. Source shadows are retained or faded for collapsed canopies/banners. B7 water is an authored draining/puddle surface with an inferred source-palette trough bottom. No physical-validity or release-approval claim.
source_geometry_limitations.blender_inspection: not opened; no geometry dimensions claimed from Blender; source metadata explicitly describes directional painted surfaces rather than certified native collision
